name: Mecklenburg County, NC
findings: Mecklenburg County has 4,606 nonprofit organizations. 2,011 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 1,599 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Mecklenburg County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Economic development organizations stand out for volunteering
observations.text: 44 economic development organizations here list volunteering, compared with about 19 in similar places of this size.
